query: How do I make peanut butter oat bars (no-bake)?

goal.title: Make peanut butter oat bars
goal.description: Measure oats and add an unlabelled brown dry ingredient, peanut butter and honey. Mix into a sticky mass, flatten it on parchment over a plate, briefly place it in the freezer, then cut it into four bars and carry the plate to a table.
goal.final_state: Four oat bars rest on parchment over a round plate. The plate is being lowered at a table; the knife has been left in the mixing bowl.

procedure.description: Flatten parchment over a round plate, open the wall cupboard and remove a white bowl. Close the cupboard, lower the bowl to the counter, pick up and open the oat canister. Retrieve the small spoon, transfer several spoonfuls of oats to the bowl, then press the canister lid on and return the canister.

Lift a small white dish of an unlabelled beige-brown crumbly ingredient. Spoon several portions into the oats, put the dish down and stir the dry ingredients repeatedly, briefly lifting the bowl. Scrape oats from the small spoon with a finger.

Pick up and unscrew the blue-lidded peanut butter jar. Scoop a large blob with the small spoon, set the jar down and use the left index finger to scrape peanut butter into the oats. Pick up the honey bottle, flip its yellow cap open, invert and squeeze honey over the bowl, close and return the bottle. Leave the small spoon on the sink drainer, open the drawer and retrieve a larger spoon.

Close the drawer and use the larger spoon to stir and press the oats, peanut butter and honey into a sticky mixture. Scrape the spoon with fingers and continue mixing. Transfer a large scoop to the parchment-lined plate, flatten it with the back of the spoon and shape its edges with the left fingers. Collect and add the remaining mixture, repeat the flattening and shaping, scrape residue from the spoon and leave it in the bowl.

Lift the parchment-lined plate and carry it to the upper freezer compartment. Open the door, slide the plate onto the wire shelf and close the door. Wait beside it with the right hand on the handle, then open the door again and remove the plate. Carry the plate back to the counter, set it down and retrieve a knife from the block.

Hold the slab steady with left fingertips while making repeated parallel knife cuts through it, separating it into four narrow bars. Lift and reposition the blade between cuts, then place the knife in the mixing bowl. Grasp the parchment-lined plate, carry it to the nearby table and lower it toward the tabletop as the clip ends.

coarse.instruction: Prepare the plate and measure oats
coarse.description: Flatten parchment on the plate, retrieve and place a mixing bowl, open the oat canister, retrieve a small spoon, transfer spoonfuls of oats and close the canister.
coarse.goal_contribution: Provides the lined surface and measured oat base for the bars.

coarse.description: Lift the ingredient dish, spoon its crumbly brown contents into the oats, return the dish, stir the dry mixture and scrape the small spoon.
coarse.goal_contribution: Distributes the additional dry ingredient throughout the oat base.
coarse.predictability_reason: Measured oats are ready for remaining dry ingredients.

coarse.description: Retrieve and open the peanut butter jar, scoop and scrape peanut butter into the bowl, open and squeeze the honey bottle, return it, put the small spoon down and fetch a larger spoon.
coarse.goal_contribution: Adds the visible sticky ingredients and obtains the utensil used to bind the mixture.
coarse.predictability_reason: The dry mix needs peanut butter and honey to bind bars.

coarse.instruction: Mix and shape the oat slab
coarse.description: Mix and press the ingredients with the large spoon, scrape it with fingers, transfer two portions to the parchment, flatten and shape the slab, then put the spoon down in the bowl.
coarse.goal_contribution: Forms a compact slab that can be chilled and divided into bars.
coarse.predictability_reason: Combined ingredients are ready to mix and shape.

coarse.instruction: Chill the oat slab and return it
coarse.description: Lift the lined plate, carry it to the freezer, open the door, place the plate inside, close and wait, reopen and retrieve it, return it to the counter and take a knife.
coarse.goal_contribution: Briefly chills the shaped slab and returns it to the cutting area.
coarse.predictability_reason: A shaped oat slab may be chilled to firm it, though it could be cut directly.

coarse.instruction: Cut and carry the oat bars
coarse.description: Steady the slab, make parallel knife cuts and reposition the blade to separate four bars, place the knife in the bowl, then lift and carry the lined plate toward the nearby table.
coarse.goal_contribution: Divides the slab into individual bars and moves them to the serving surface.
coarse.predictability_reason: The chilled slab is ready to cut into bars.
